code:
SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    CASE WHEN c.StoreID IS NOT NULL
         THEN 'Store/Reseller' ELSE 'Individual' END AS CustomerSegment,
    soh.SalesOrderID, soh.OrderDate, sod.LineTotal
FROM Sales.Customer AS c
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh ON soh.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
WHERE soh.Status = 5;
caption: Status = 5 restricts both extracts to shipped (completed) orders.

code:
SELECT
    st.TerritoryID, st.Name AS TerritoryName, st.Group AS TerritoryGroup,
    soh.SalesOrderID, soh.OrderDate, sod.LineTotal
FROM Sales.SalesTerritory AS st
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh ON soh.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
WHERE soh.Status = 5;
caption: Same order data, joined through a different dimension.

eyebrow: Why both extracts are bigger than expected
